name: puncTure
source:
People enjoy eternal life and die only when they wish to. That changes with the birth of a girl that has a power to bring death to the loved ones. She is sealed in the ancient ruin because of her dangerous gift.
Some time later a crazy nobleman finds her and orders main character to train her and nurture hate feelings in her instead of love.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
人们享受永生，只有在愿意的时候才会死去。随着一个女孩的诞生，这种情况发生了变化，她有能力给所爱的人带来死亡。由于她危险的天赋，她被封印在远古废墟中。
一段时间后，一位疯狂的贵族找到了她，并命令主角训练她并在她心中培养仇恨而不是爱。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
